title: reqchain API definition
description: Describes a reqchain API definition file: a named collection of HTTP endpoints, their auth, and the variables that parameterize them.

schemaVersion.description: The format version this file was written against. This build understands version 1 only.

id.description: A short, stable, unique identifier for this API definition.

name.description: A human-readable display name for this API.

baseUrl.description: The URL prefix prepended to every endpoint's path, may itself contain {{variable}} references.

variables.description: API-level variables available to every endpoint, keyed by name, lowest precedence of the three variable scopes.

environments.description: Named sets of variable overrides, such as `test` or `prod`, selectable at run time.

auth.description: The API-level auth, used by any endpoint whose own auth is `inherit`.

endpoints.description: The HTTP endpoints this API exposes.

environment.description: A named environment that overrides API-level variables when selected.

name.description: The environment's name, such as `test` or `prod`.

variables.description: Variable overrides for this environment, keyed by name, middle precedence of the three variable scopes.

endpoint.description: A single HTTP endpoint: its method, path, headers, query, body and auth.

id.description: A short, stable, unique identifier for this endpoint within the API.

name.description: A human-readable display name for this endpoint.

method.description: The HTTP method used for this endpoint's requests.

path.description: The URL path appended to the API's baseUrl, may contain {{variable}} references.

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with this endpoint's requests, keyed by header name.

additionalProperties.description: The header's value, may contain {{variable}} references.

query.description: Query string parameters to send with this endpoint's requests, keyed by parameter name.

additionalProperties.description: The parameter's value, may contain {{variable}} references.

variables.description: Endpoint-level variables, keyed by name, highest precedence of the three variable scopes.

auth.description: The auth used for this endpoint's requests; defaults to `inherit` from the API-level auth.

body.description: The request body sent with this endpoint's requests, if any.

oneOf.description: A JSON request body.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a JSON body.

content.description: The JSON value to send as the request body.

oneOf.description: A URL-encoded form request body.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a form body.

fields.description: Form fields to send, keyed by field name.

additionalProperties.description: The field's value, may contain {{variable}} references.

oneOf.description: A multipart/form-data request body.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a multipart body.

fields.description: Text fields to send, keyed by field name.

additionalProperties.description: The field's value, may contain {{variable}} references.

files.description: File fields to send, keyed by field name, each value a filesystem path.

additionalProperties.description: The path to the file to upload, may contain {{variable}} references.

oneOf.description: A plain-text request body.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a text body.

content.description: The text to send as the request body, may contain {{variable}} references.

oneOf.description: An XML request body.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as an XML body.

content.description: The XML text to send as the request body, may contain {{variable}} references.

oneOf.description: A binary request body read from a file.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a binary body.

path.description: The path to the file whose bytes are sent as the request body, may contain {{variable}} references.

oneOf.description: Inherit the auth from the enclosing scope (API-level for an endpoint; treated as `none` at API level).

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as inherited auth.

oneOf.description: Send no auth at all.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as no auth.

oneOf.description: HTTP Basic auth.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as Basic auth.

oneOf.description: A static bearer token sent in the Authorization header.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as bearer auth.

token.description: The bearer token, may contain {{variable}} references.

oneOf.description: One or more static headers used for auth.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as header auth.

headers.description: Headers to send, keyed by header name.

additionalProperties.description: The header's value, may contain {{variable}} references.

oneOf.description: A header whose value is computed from an expression at request time.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as computed auth.

name.description: The name of the header to set with the computed value.

expression.description: The expression to evaluate, such as `md5(now("YYYYMMDD") + {{person_id}})`.

oneOf.description: A token fetched by calling another endpoint first, cached, and injected into requests.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this as chained auth.

source.description: The endpoint to call to obtain the token.

extract.description: How to extract the token from the source endpoint's response; defaults to $.access_token in the response body.

ttl.description: How to determine the token's time-to-live; defaults to $.expires_in seconds in the response body.

inject.description: Where to place the token in subsequent requests.

retryOn.description: HTTP status codes on which to refetch the token and retry once; defaults to [401, 403].

items.description: An HTTP status code that should trigger a token refresh and retry.

chainSource.description: Identifies the endpoint that a chained auth calls to obtain its token.

endpoint.description: The id of the endpoint to call to obtain the token.

extract.description: How to extract a chained-auth token from its source endpoint's response, discriminated by `from`.

oneOf.description: Extract the token from the response body.

from.description: Discriminator identifying this as body extraction.

jsonPath.description: A JSONPath expression selecting the token within the response body.

xpath.description: An XPath expression selecting the token within the response body. Not yet implemented — validation rejects this.

regex.description: A regular expression whose first capture group is the token.

oneOf.description: Extract the token from a response header.

from.description: Discriminator identifying this as header extraction.

name.description: The name of the response header containing the token.

regex.description: A regular expression whose first capture group is the token within the header value.

oneOf.description: Use the response's HTTP status as the token (rare; mainly for probing).

from.description: Discriminator identifying this as status extraction.

ttl.description: How to determine a chained-auth token's time-to-live, discriminated by `from`.

oneOf.description: The response body reports how many units of time the token remains valid, relative to when it was fetched.

from.description: Discriminator identifying this as a relative body-derived ttl.

jsonPath.description: A JSONPath expression selecting the relative lifetime within the response body.

unit.description: The unit the lifetime value is expressed in; defaults to `seconds`. Only `seconds` and `milliseconds` are accepted.

oneOf.description: The token is valid for a fixed number of seconds from when it was fetched.

from.description: Discriminator identifying this as a fixed ttl.

seconds.description: The number of seconds the token remains valid after being fetched.

oneOf.description: The response body reports an absolute expiry timestamp for the token.

from.description: Discriminator identifying this as an absolute body-derived ttl.

jsonPath.description: A JSONPath expression selecting the absolute expiry timestamp within the response body.

inject.description: Where a chained-auth token is placed in subsequent requests, discriminated by `into`.

oneOf.description: Inject the token into a request header.

into.description: Discriminator identifying this as header injection.

name.description: The name of the header to set with the token.

template.description: The header value template, containing {{value}} where the token is substituted.

oneOf.description: Inject the token into a query string parameter.

into.description: Discriminator identifying this as query injection.

name.description: The name of the query parameter to set with the token.

template.description: The query value template, containing {{value}} where the token is substituted; defaults to `{{value}}`.

oneOf.description: Inject the token into the request body at a JSON pointer.

into.description: Discriminator identifying this as body injection.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer identifying where in the request body to set the token.

template.description: The body value template, containing {{value}} where the token is substituted; defaults to `{{value}}`.
